metadata.description: KBD probes for the Weeks 9-10 alpha-sweep (Docs/TODO.md, RQ2). Three archetype pairs, each probed bidirectionally: does archetype A confirm B's exclusive facts (and vice versa) as the blend ratio shifts? Reuses data/processed/knowledge_base.json's existing items (all 8 archetypes already have 2-3 facts each from Week 6) rather than authoring a new knowledge base. Original hand-authored content.
